# Face fixtures

Public-domain official portraits used by the real-model face tests. They are works of the United States federal government, so they carry no copyright (17 U.S.C. § 105). No office capture or photo of a colleague belongs in this folder, because the repository is public.

| File | Person | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `obama-2012.jpg` | Barack Obama | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Barack_Obama.jpg (Pete Souza, White House, 2012) |
| `obama-2009.jpg` | Barack Obama | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Official_portrait_of_Barack_Obama.jpg (Pete Souza, White House, 2009) |
| `biden-2021.jpg` | Joe Biden | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Joe_Biden_presidential_portrait.jpg (Adam Schultz, White House, 2021) |

Each was fetched at 480 px wide through Wikimedia's `Special:FilePath`.
